name: The Unnamed Hollow Mouth
loreTies: The Hollow Mouth speaks from Gate wounds where identity has been erased. It is not a Realm civilization. It is the sound left after names, oaths, laws, and memories are consumed.
Erasure consumes what civilizations fail to defend.
shortBackstory: The Unnamed Hollow Mouth is the Hollow witness whose choices explain how The First Reopening changes more than the battlefield.

chapters.title: Before the Gate Spoke
chapters.text: The Unnamed Hollow Mouth was important before battle records named them. As voice of the empty gate, The Unnamed learned the hidden machinery beneath the Hollow wound: who records law, who witnesses oath, who warns the living world, and who profits when warnings are ignored.

chapters.title: Faction Duty
chapters.text: The Unnamed's loyalty is tied to Hollow culture rather than battlefield glory. Their doctrine is simple and dangerous: Erasure consumes what civilizations fail to defend. The story needs them because Deities can win fights and still misunderstand what victory costs.

chapters.title: Story Arc Tie
chapters.text: During The First Reopening, The Unnamed becomes a readable witness to campaign consequence. Their first appearance, Campaign 01: The First Reopening, places them where player decisions need interpretation, warning, and memory instead of another controllable unit.

chapters.title: Conflict Wound
chapters.text: The Gate pressures The Unnamed through knowledge. It offers signs that are useful but incomplete, trying to turn witness into accomplice. Their recurring conflict is whether to reveal truth early and risk panic, or wait for proof and risk lives.

chapters.title: Dashboard Role
chapters.text: As a non-playable character, The Unnamed belongs under Characters and Character Backstories. Their profile should be read beside campaign dialogue, codex unlocks, and faction pages so every briefing feels like canon consequence, not tutorial flavor.

developmentStatus: Readable NPC profile integrated into dashboard character pages.
